m2-add-grid-metric.title: B1(b): Add grid-relationship metric to script
m2-add-grid-metric.imperative: Add a compute_grid_relationship(car_times_s, pos_times_s) function that returns: per-stream base tick (modal dt quantum in seconds), car row count vs pos row count, timestamp overlap fraction (fraction of pos timestamps that exactly coincide with a car timestamp within 1ms tolerance), and median nearest-neighbour time distance between the two grids (seconds). Call this per driver and store in the per-session JSON under a 'grid_relationship' key. Also aggregate across drivers into 'headline.grid_relationship_aggregate'. Attest c1.
